the development of a mucosal vaccine candidate for cross-neutralization of diverse HPV types using the pgsA protein as a display platform.
a new approach for the development of a prophylactic vaccine against diverse types of HPVs.
the development of an oral vaccine candidate against HPV infection using L. casei as a vector.

oral vaccination of L. caseis displaying HPV-16 L 2 induced cross-neutralization of diverse HPV types and genital infection.

oral immunization with HPV-16L2-L. casei induces neutralizing antibodies that cross-react with diverse HPV types.
